title: Spiders and their webs
examples: How many legs do spiders have?
What is spider silk used for?
Does a spider build its web in one piece?

explain.say: A spider has eight legs. You can count them all around.
Spiders make their webs by spinning silk. This silk is very strong.
The web helps the spider catch its food. It is like a sticky net.
Sometimes spiders use their silk to hang themselves. This keeps them safe.
In real life, you see spider webs in gardens. They catch little insects for dinner.
A common mistake is thinking spiders only use silk for webs. They use it for many things.

draw.text: Silk used for more than webs.

faq.a: No, some spiders do not build webs at all. They might hunt on the ground instead.

faq.q: How strong is the silk they spin?
faq.a: Spider silk is incredibly strong for its weight. It is often stronger than steel.
asks: What is the strength of spider silk?

faq.a: Spiders mainly eat small insects and other tiny creatures. They catch them in their web.
asks: Does a spider eat big things?

faq.q: How many legs do spiders have?
faq.a: Spiders always have eight legs. This is different from insects which have six legs.
asks: How many legs on a spider?
Does a spider have six or eight legs?

faq.q: Can spiders spin silk for other things?
faq.a: Yes, they use silk to wrap themselves or to make safety lines. It is very useful.
asks: What else is silk used for?

facts: Spiders have eight legs, unlike insects which have six.
They produce silk from special glands in their bodies.
The web is used to trap small prey like flies and moths.
Spider silk is known for being very strong and light.

quiz.say: A spider has how many legs?
quiz.why: Spiders are arachnids and always have eight legs.

wrong.1: Six legs belong to insects, not spiders.
wrong.2: Four legs are usually found on things like dogs or cats.
wrong.3: There is no scientific reason for spiders to have ten legs.

quiz.say: What is the main purpose of the web?
quiz.why: The sticky web is designed to trap small creatures for the spider to eat.

wrong.1: While it is a home, its primary function is catching food.
wrong.2: The web is usually suspended between objects, not for walking.
wrong.3: The silk is the material; the web is what it creates to catch things.

quiz.say: If a spider needs to hang from a branch, what does it use?
quiz.why: Spiders use their strong silk to create safety lines or anchor points.

wrong.0: It must use material it produces, which is silk.
wrong.2: Its legs are for walking, not for hanging a large weight.
wrong.3: Using its body would be too heavy and might break.
